note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026, read again in that of 30 October 2026), Thailand, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahweal992j) and average post-tax national income (adiinc992j) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, in THB of that year, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. Read 2026-10-30. Read again 2026-11-03 from the bulk download of 30 October 2026 (its country files dated 30 October 2026): every row quoted here, its year and its currency label stood as before, and no later year was given. Until 2026-11-03 this note and its sources wrote the variable codes with their age and population parts swapped (ahwealj992 for ahweal992j and adiincj992 for adiinc992j), codes no file of the database holds (its README: type, concept, age group, population, as in sptinc992j), and called adiinc992j post-tax disposable income, which its metadata names post-tax national income ([Post-tax national income]=[Post-tax disposable income]+[Public spending]). The national accounts (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-03: each band's income scaled by households' disposable income over national income), searched again on 2026-11-03 in the statistics office's own accounts: the NESDC's Table of National Accounts 2024 (NI2024-4.xlsx, published 30 December 2025), 2024 (preliminary): the net disposable income (B.6n) of households with the non-profit institutions serving them (S.14+S.15, Table 53, nothing narrower published), 11,096,677 less 236,953 (10,859,724), derived as the gross less its own consumption of fixed capital from the same table and year, and net national income (B.5n, Table 50) 14,885,487, as published, in millions of baht, a ratio of about 0.730 (`cash`). The derived figure matched the table's own net disposable income per head times its population (154,668.28 baht times 70,213,000). Until 2026-11-03 each band's income was the database's post-tax national income as it stood, public spending included.
